result.cache_policy: Fresh processes and advisory per-file fsync/FADV_DONTNEED before source phases; first indexed query follows strict replay; three warm queries reuse the session. Device caches uncontrolled.
limitations: Diagnostic phases include full sink verification; batch production includes I/O, decoding and column assembly, not a sampled function profile
Instant per batch adds instrumentation overhead; no subtraction or count-only performance claim
Small profiles are not independent oversized acceptance or parallel speedup qualification
Source read counters are per single-threaded worker; future concurrent deltas require separate accounting
Native eager metadata reference has a separate cap; Linux timings/RSS are not cross-platform measurements

paired_development_probe.scope: Paired development regression probe; same source, affinity, limits and validating sink; not independent out-of-core acceptance
paired_development_probe.cache_policy: Warm OS cache following complete native readback; no eviction; three pairs with alternating old/new order

findings.issue: Accepted limits cannot represent a raw ordinal end when filters reject rows
findings.disposition: Track raw progress independently of accepted rows; enforce interior end before decoding again, with all-rejected and projected/limited regressions.

findings.issue: A final raw ordinal does not imply EOF framing has been consumed
findings.disposition: Retain pending EOF iteration for fully consumed nonempty ranges; preserve explicit accepted-limit and empty-range laziness, test sticky corrupted terminators.

findings.issue: A tiny range needlessly requesting a maximum-size batch can fail a sufficient shared root
findings.disposition: Bound batch capacity by possible raw rows as well as payload/accepted limits, keeping one no-output EOF iteration. Verify a three-row default-cap range under a one-MiB root.

findings.issue: Aliased empty-range construction may need catalog I/O without record consumption
findings.disposition: Document structural metadata resolution separately and test no I/O during lazy next_batch, plus direct no-record/no-codec fault guards.

findings.issue: Restart ownership must not require revalidating a sidecar per range
findings.disposition: Copy the opaque tuple into the charged cursor. Test index/checkpoint drop and overwritten sidecar after construction, with exact frozen native output and source binding.

findings.issue: Separate cold timing cohorts cannot attribute a serial-path difference to code
findings.disposition: Keep complete cold raw observations and dispersion. Add matched fixed-affinity old/new warm probes with identical native-verified inputs and full sinks; no general performance qualification inferred.

limits: Serial ranges only; no workers, automatic policy, new dependency or format change
Unindexed catalog total is a bound, not independent full-stream verification; persistent checkpoint trust still requires strict source hashing/canonical replay
Existing immutable-source length/mtime assumptions remain; no CAS or indistinguishable concurrent edit guarantee
Range correctness/root tests do not independently prove new larger-than-RAM/RSS acceptance; task 040 gates parallel containment and performance
M6 capped diagnostic profiles exercise existing ordinary paths and retain cold/cache/sink limitations; paired warm comparisons are scoped development probes
Native macOS/Windows functionality results are not Linux containment/timing measurements
Full M3/M4/M5 scale gates were not rerun for this serial range task; no new milestone release claim
